_comment: Curation memory for mattpocock/skills upstream sync (ADR-0002 principle #6). Records skill-level adopt/keep/skip decisions so future syncs don't re-litigate them. check-mattpocock-updates.ps1 reads hunk-level entries (with hunkContentHash); the skill-decision entries below are documentation for human/agent curation and are ignored by the hunk matcher.

reason: Upstream deleted it as maintainer curation, not obsolescence. Mapping an unfamiliar code area before local changes is still valuable for our consumers. Keep with this documented reason (ADR-0002: deviate-with-reason).
Upstream removed it; we keep the ultra-compressed output mode (useful, self-contained, no upstream dependency).
Upstream replaced it with writing-great-skills (a reference-style rewrite). We keep write-a-skill as an actionable command; see writing-great-skills (defer) below.
